name: A Way Home!
summary: This app is designed to spread knowledge about 1) The need for ALL children to have equal rights, as not all do, 2) a treaty that lists these rights ALL children should be afforded called the Convention on the Rights of the Child treaty, and 3) ALL but one nation has ratified it. The USA is still outstanding as of 2024. More info about the game: https://www.suzanneensmann.com/a-way-home.html
